A1_vocabulary.measurement: in-series readings named in the description 92.1%, off-series 24.7%
A1_vocabulary.acceptance_test: roadmap asked for >=95% recall verified by hand-checking 20 patents
A1_vocabulary.result: 92.1% via an automated in-series proxy; the hand check was NOT performed
A1_vocabulary.verdict: FELL SHORT of its own acceptance test, recorded rather than waived

A2_wrong_text_gate.finding: 360 of 1451 texted labels (24.8%) carried a numeral the patent never names
examples: EP2020016B1 read 8,8,8,8,8,8 in a drawing numbered 10,102,12,14
EP2099533B1 read 316,319,322,325 off the described series
A2_wrong_text_gate.note: shipped inert in v1 -- in_vocabulary was computed and never persisted, so the check could not fire and 83 figures were accepted without it. Found and fixed.

A3_closed_set_recognition.negative_control: crops the elongation gate rejected as line fragments

one_character_match.verdict: no information -- the dictionary was accepting noise, not reading it

two_character_match.note: 0 of 70; the 95% upper bound on that rate is about 4%

A3_closed_set_recognition.impact_of_the_gate: 149 of 177 closed-set labels were fabrications. Removing them changed acceptance by ZERO, so the defect was invisible in the headline number.

rejected_repairs.widened_crop_reread: 72.5% 'recovered' but the examples were 8->1 at confidence 1.00 and 5->11: the same fabrication in a different costume

A4_demotion.decision: owner chose to trade a missing label for a wrong one
A4_demotion.behaviour: an out-of-vocabulary reading keeps its removal and its crop but drops the numeral claim, recorded as unidentified_mark with a demoted_from trail
A4_demotion.cost_made_visible: every acceptance record carries labels_total, labels_demoted_unreadable and labels_unidentified

A5_caption_suppression: blacklisted OCR boxes become taken regions so caption letters are not re-added as unknown labels

D2_wrong_text_rate.actual: not met by correction; 311 wrong readings are discarded rather than fixed, which is the chosen trade

remaining: All 14 unaccepted figures fail before acceptance: 12 gated at Stage 2, 1 at Stage 1, 1 at Stage 3. Acceptance itself blocks nothing.
